options.name: Burn, but no transaction fee increase
options.text: Do not increase transaction fees and burn 100% of existing fees.

options.text: Increase transaction fees by 10x and burn 100% of transaction fees.

options.name: Increase 100x with Burn
options.text: Increase transaction fees by 100x and burn 100% of transaction fees.

options.name: Increase 10x without Burn
options.text: Increase transaction fees by 10x and do not burn the transaction fees.

options.name: Increase 100x without Burn
options.text: Increase transaction fees by 100x and do not burn the transaction fees.
